notes: WhaleChat 3.57.0 — account and investing upgrade: the dashboard card is larger with the renamed stocks-trade button plus WC-invest and vendor shortcuts; My account is the default screen after sign-in/sign-up; sign-up and password reset use a 6-digit code emailed to the user with an in-app fallback; the transaction PIN is now set or reset from Settings (no PIN popup at sign-up); every active WC-Investing plan draws its own green/red ROI chart with 20–100% progress ticks; stock charts render locally in TradingView style when offline; the offline banner no longer covers the tab bar; Twelve Data lists exactly 10 stocks while Binance lists 112 crypto pairs (162 markets total); accounts and balances are mirrored to Appwrite and restored after a redeploy or a sleeping instance.
